name: vtrace
description: Repo-bound, local-first code indexing and MCP tool.

scripts.format:check: prettier --ignore-unknown --check README.md docs/**/*.md package.json tsconfig.json .github/workflows/*.yml LICENSE CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md
scripts.format: prettier --ignore-unknown --write README.md docs/**/*.md package.json tsconfig.json .github/workflows/*.yml LICENSE CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md
scripts.package:vscode: bun run vscode:copy-bin && cd vscode-extension && ../node_modules/.bin/vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license --out vtrace-vscode.vsix
